title: Extract fieldwork::fetch_remote module
description:
Remote actor fetch, key extraction, and WebFinger resolution. ~100 lines per project, repeated in inbox handler, relay management, and actor cache across all three.

Source: GJ federation.rs:190-300 (FederationClient with fetch_actor + resolve_webfinger), BS actor_cache.rs + server.rs inbox handler.

Public API:
- RemoteActorData struct { actor_uri, inbox_uri, shared_inbox_uri, public_key_pem, key_id, display_name, username, avatar_url }
- fetch_remote_actor(client: &reqwest::Client, actor_uri: &str) -> Result<RemoteActorData> — GET actor with Accept: application/activity+json, body limit 65KB, parse JSON, extract publicKey fields, validate publicKey.owner matches actor_uri
- resolve_webfinger(client: &reqwest::Client, user: &str, domain: &str) -> Result<String> — fetch .well-known/webfinger, parse JRD, find self link with AP media type
- fetch_actor_key(client: &reqwest::Client, key_id: &str) -> Result<(String, String)> — fetch actor by keyId (stripping fragment), return (public_key_pem, actor_uri)

What stays in consumers: Actor cache management, DB upsert of remote accounts.

Deps: reqwest, serde_json, ssrf-guard (for URL validation), url.

Security: SSRF validation on all outbound URLs. Body size limits on all fetches (65KB). Validate publicKey.owner matches requested actor URI (prevent key substitution). Sign GET requests with cavage-httpsig.
close_reason: All 7 modules extracted, 134 tests pass with full+db-sqlite features.
